title: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: The three rolling production ledgers were refreshed on October 20, keeping the market read, photo rights, and open questions current.

chapterHighlights: A team of makers who shaped the early cap business and then slipped out of the story.
The wool, the stitching, and the shape that has barely changed in a century and a half.
